chunks: When they persevered and firmly believed Our revelations, We appointed learned men among them who guided them by Our command.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Imams appointed by God according to Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the doctrine of Imamate, with many scholars identifying the 'Imams' as the Twelve Imams, particularly Ali ibn Abi Talib and his progeny, who exemplified steadfast patience (sabr) and certainty (yaqin). The phrase 'by His command' (bi-amrihi) underscores their divine appointment (nass), distinguishing them from merely elected leaders, while their unwavering faith in divine signs serves as the prerequisite for this spiritual authority.
